“Apples so good, they never go bad.”

**Dandy Boy Apples** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Dandy Boy Apples were made by a pre-War company. On the front and sides of the box, there is some sort of apple mascot with a bowler hat, monocle, and mustache.

- Two can be found near Audio Tour Station #1 in Uncanny Caverns.
- Two can be found in the kitchen of the diner in Summersville.
- One can be found in the Morgantown's Red Rocket.
- One may be found in the fridge within the kitchen inside Garrahan Mining Headquarters.
